grammar.title: The Conditional Tense for Polite Requests
grammar.explanation:
The conditional tense is widely used in formal and professional Spanish for polite requests and suggestions:

• Formation: infinitive + -ía, -ías, -ía, -íamos, -íais, -ían
  Responder → respondería (I would respond)
  Poder → podría (could)

Common polite expressions:
• ¿Podría usted...? - Could you...?
• ¿Sería posible...? - Would it be possible...?
• Le agradecería que... - I would appreciate it if...
• Me gustaría... - I would like...

This is much more formal than using the present tense for requests.
